title: To take certain Federal lands located in Lassen County, California, into trust for the benefit of the Susanville Indian Rancheria, and for other purposes.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the House on October 27, 2015. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill takes into trust for the benefit of the Susanville Indian Rancheria approximately 301 acres of federal land under the administrative jurisdiction of the Bureau of Land Management in Lassen County, California.

Certain gaming on these lands is prohibited.

summary.headline: This law moves about 301 acres of federal land in Lassen County, California, into trust for the Susanville Indian Rancheria and bars certain gaming on that land.
summary.what_it_does: The law takes roughly 301 acres of land managed by the Bureau of Land Management in Lassen County, California, and places it in trust for the Susanville Indian Rancheria. Land held in trust is generally held by the federal government for a tribe's benefit rather than managed by the Bureau of Land Management. The law also prohibits certain gaming on these lands. The official summary does not describe any health provisions, even though the policy area listed for this law is Health.

who_it_affects.how: The tribe gains trust status over about 301 acres of federal land, but certain gaming on those lands is not allowed.

who_it_affects.group: People who use these BLM lands in Lassen County
who_it_affects.how: The land moves out of Bureau of Land Management administration into trust, which changes who manages it. The summary does not say how public access or use will change.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 22, 2016. The official summary does not list a separate effective date.
